title: Test four signed magnetic families against Fourier coefficients
supersedes: The initial opposite-shift-only proposal; it does not itself escape the support restriction.
model: Odd N>=3, char(field) not dividing N, supplied primitive Nth root omega; S e_i=e_(i+1), T e_i=omega^i e_i; K=N.
exact_setup: For (epsilon,delta) in {+1,-1}^2, set Q_(j,epsilon,delta)=I-alpha_(epsilon,delta) S^epsilon-beta_(epsilon,delta) omega^j T^delta, A_(epsilon,delta)=(1/N) sum_j w_(j,epsilon,delta) Q_(j,epsilon,delta)^(-1). Each parameter pair satisfies 1-beta_(epsilon,delta)^N-alpha_(epsilon,delta)^N !=0. Study equality F_N=sum_(epsilon,delta) A_(epsilon,delta).
root_derived_claims_pending_review: One signed family has support contained in T_(epsilon,delta)={(a,b):[epsilon*a]_N+[delta*b]_N<=N-1}.
Two opposite shift directions with the same phase direction still miss the b=N-1 slice except a=0.
Any three of the four signed triangles miss a diagonal ray; for (++),(+-),(-+), points a=b>=(N+1)/2 are missing.
All four signed triangles cover the Weyl grid for odd N, by choosing least absolute residues independently.
next_questions: Independently verify the signed support-completeness gate, including field and small-N hypotheses.
Once support is complete, determine whether the four-sector coefficient-ratio identities can realize Fourier for arbitrarily large odd N or instead imply a guarded exclusion.
Only after a valid full-matrix identity is found, separately assess coefficient/weight preparation, inverses, storage, and all-output execution cost.
scope_limit: These are root-derived proposed claims and questions, not part of the frozen independently accepted Phase18 theorem. Support completeness alone neither constructs Fourier nor proves an algorithmic runtime.
